text_block_list.text:
At last, the day of Уиннинг Тикит's
debut has
arrived.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As her trainer, I must keep her spirits
high,
because she starts getting itchy
when she feels
anxious.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Overcoming her nerves—and
itchiness—she heads
off to her debut!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
